body.statement: For \(d\geq4\), determine whether every nonconstant homogeneous exactly self-normalizing \(D_d\in\mathbb R[Sd]\) admits one common complete invariant flag for its relative gradients, or construct the least-dimensional polynomial counterexample with varying spectral data and certify that no recursive flag represents it.
body.justification: Dimension three is the last setting where the first spectral power sums discretize the spectrum, so higher dimensions require a new invariant-flag mechanism.
body.gap: Tamano's all-dimensional converse assumes a common invariant flag, while Tunçel--Vandenberghe derive recursive flags from homogeneous-cone automorphisms rather than from self-normalization.
body.consumer: A resolution would delimit complete denominator auditing for rational causal certificates using more than three covariance directions.

obligation.what_is_open: Determine whether the self-normalization equations in dimensions at least four force a recursive common invariant flag in every higher-corank branch, or construct and certify a counterexample.
obligation.obstruction: When the positive-semidefinite gradient has corank at least two, its adjugate vanishes, so determinant differentiation produces no nonzero translation direction.  Moreover, the first two spectral power sums supplied by homogeneity and self-normalization do not determine a spectrum with four or more entries.
obligation.attempted: The adjugate-translation and two-sided cone-order argument was generalized to arbitrary dimension and completely closes the corank-one case.  Direct replacement of the adjugate by lower cofactors was examined, but determinant differentiation does not show that the corresponding lower-cofactor direction is annihilated by the Hessian, so the finite translation step is unavailable.
obligation.partial_result: The proved all-dimensional corank-one rigidity lemma shows that whenever a candidate branch has \(G_{D_d}\succeq0\), \(\det G_{D_d}\equiv0\), and rank \(d-1\) at one positive-definite point, its kernel line is globally constant.  Thus the higher-dimensional question is closed for the corank-one branch.  The unresolved cases have generic rank at most \(d-2\), where \(\operatorname{adj}G_{D_d}\equiv0\) and the present translation direction disappears.
